mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 30 days (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%), a monthly decline in industrial production signals impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually and INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases over the prior 30 days (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline in the prior month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive policy action that reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
